procedural_matters: Uros Zvan presented the case on behalf of the international Jury
Crew of SUI 8549 Patrick Schenk acted as a translator for CHRISTOPH Gautschi.
facts: SUI 8549 approached windward mark no. 1 on starboard below the layline.
SUI 8549 luffed just before the mark and touch it with her port side amidship.
SUI 8549 stayed in the contact with the mark until she left it astern.
SUI 8549 didn't take a penalty turn before she reached the offset mark.
The distance between mark 1 and the offset mark was 100 meters (45 seconds).
There were no other boats racing leeward of SUI 8549.
SUI 8549 took a penalty turn after rounding the offset mark a minute after the incident.
conclusions: SUI 8549 touched mark no. 1 and broke RRS 31.
By delaying her penalty turns by 60 seconds after getting well clear of other boats after the incident SUI 8549 failed to comply with the requirements of RRS 44.2.
decision: SUI 8549 is DSQ in race no. 5.
